lines.en: label ioarchery1:
scene ioarchery1
The desire to see small girls wielding dangerous weapons beckons me toward the archery club’s morning meeting.
lines.zh: 想看小个子女生摆弄危险武器的念头，把我召唤到了弓道社的晨练现场。

lines.en: But it is upon the realization of this desire that I transition into wanting to see small girls who are not wielding dangerous weapons, as doing so detracts from the attention I should be receiving.
lines.zh: 可这个念头刚一实现，我就转而想看不摆弄危险武器的小个子女生了——因为那样会分走本该属于我的注意力。

lines.en: At least one teacher is the recipient of such attention, though. But what I don’t like about that is that she probably has just as much of a chance at sleeping with Uta as I do.
lines.zh: 不过至少有一位老师得到了这种关注。但让我不爽的是，她和 Uta 上床的机会大概跟我一样大。

lines.en: If only I knew how to use a bow. Maybe then I could launch Cupid’s arrow straight through the heart of everyone here and take them all back to my house for one giant, ponytail-filled orgy.
lines.zh: 要是我会射箭就好了。那样我就能把丘比特之箭径直射穿这里每个人的心脏，然后把她们全带回我家，办一场巨大的、满是马尾辫的群交派对。

lines.en: : Your grip on the arrow is too loose. And if you don’t start straightening out your wrist, you’re going to cause serious damage to it.
lines.zh: : 你握箭的手太松了。再不把手腕伸直，你会把腕子弄出严重损伤的。

lines.en: : But I’ve hit the target every single time.
lines.zh: : 可我每一次都射中靶子了啊。

lines.en: : That doesn’t mean you’re not making any mistakes. What good is hitting the target at all if your method in doing so could lead to injury?
lines.zh: : 那不代表你没犯错。如果你的方法迟早会让你受伤，射中靶子又有什么意义？

lines.en: : Try it again but focus on your wrist instead of hitting the target. Missing right now is fine so long as you develop proper form.
lines.zh: : 再来一次，不过这次把注意力放在手腕上，别管中没中靶。现在射偏没关系，只要把姿势练对就行。

lines.en: : Are your hands always this cold, Miss Watabe?
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师，你的手一直都这么冷吗？

lines.en: : Everything is cold when you’re dead inside. Now, do what I tell you as you’re the one girl here who’s shown any amount of promise so far.
lines.zh: : 里面死透了，什么都冷。现在照我说的做——你是这儿到目前为止唯一表现出点天赋的姑娘。

lines.en: scene ioarchery2
: Sensei! Good morning. I didn’t realize you were going to be here today.
lines.zh: : Sensei！早上好。我不知道你今天会来。

lines.en: : I didn’t realize you were going to be here today either. Since when do you participate in literally anything?
lines.zh: : 我也不知道你今天会来。你从什么时候开始参加任何活动了？

lines.en: : Oh, I’m not participating. I’ve been sitting under a tree and waiting for Uta to finish since we got here.
lines.zh: : 哦，我没参加。从到这儿起我就一直坐在树下等 Uta 练完。

lines.en: : She’s weirdly adamant about this archery stuff and her desire to drag me down with her has become very annoying.
lines.zh: : 她对弓道这事执着得有点诡异，还非要拉我一起下水，烦死了。

lines.en: : I did find a really cool caterpillar, though. Hanging out with him was a good use of like, twenty minutes. But I just put him back on the tree since I like you a little more than bugs.
lines.zh: : 不过我倒是找到一只超酷的毛毛虫。跟它待了大概二十分钟，挺好的。但我刚把它放回树上了，因为我喜欢你比喜欢虫子多一点点。

lines.en: : Just a little?
lines.zh: : 就一点点？

lines.en: : Or a lot if saying “a lot” gets you to like me more. I also spent twenty minutes figuring out things to say that would make me sound less clingy, but in true Io fashion, I have already given up.
lines.zh: : 要说「很多」能让你更喜欢我，那就是很多。我还花了二十分钟想些让自己听起来不那么黏人的话，但按 Io 的一贯作风，我已经放弃了。

lines.en: : I’m fine with your...adhesiveness. It would just probably be a little smarter to not say things like that in a place where Kirin could easily gain access to a weapon.
lines.zh: : 你那点……黏人劲儿我没意见。只是别在这种 Kirin 随手就能摸到武器的地方说这种话，可能更明智一点。

lines.en: : Don’t worry, Sensei. I would take the arrow for you.
lines.zh: : 别担心，Sensei。我会替你挡下那一箭的。

lines.en: : I was more suggesting that you’d be the one she shoots.
lines.zh: : 我更想说的是，她要射的是你。

lines.en: scene ioarchery3
: Oh, well that’s no big deal. Uta’s a better shot than her and she’d protect me.
lines.zh: : 哦，那没什么大不了的。Uta 比她射得准，她会保护我的。

lines.en: : Would Uta...not protect me?
lines.zh: : Uta 就……不会保护我吗？

lines.en: : Idunno. Maybe? She does like you. I just don’t know if she likes you enough to murder someone.
lines.zh: : 不造。也许吧？她确实喜欢你。我只是不知道她喜欢你到没到愿意去杀人的程度。

lines.en: : Are you saying you do like me enough to murder someone?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你喜欢我到了愿意去杀人的程度？

lines.en: : Sometimes, I think about murdering people for reasons that don’t even pertain to you. So probably.
lines.zh: : 有时候我想杀人，理由跟你一点关系都没有。所以大概吧。

lines.en: : You’re just a walking red flag, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 你就是个会走路的危险信号，对吧？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. I’m surprised you don’t just walk past me at this point.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。我都奇怪你到现在怎么没直接从我身边走过去。

lines.en: : If you weren’t so cute, I probably would.
lines.zh: : 如果你没这么可爱，我大概早就走了。

lines.en: : My mind tells me that I should be saddened by that response, but my mind sucks so I am going to ignore that and just revel in the fact that I’m cute enough to stop you in your tracks.
lines.zh: : 我的理智告诉我该为这句话难过，但我的理智很烂，所以我打算无视它，单纯陶醉在「我可爱到能让你停下脚步」这件事里。

lines.en: : Uta’s so cool, isn’t she? I wonder if I’ll ever be able to draw a bow like that.
lines.zh: : Uta 好厉害啊，是不是？不知道我有没有一天能像她那样拉弓。

lines.en: : If only there was some sort of place you could practice.
lines.zh: : 要是有个能练习的地方就好了。

lines.en: : Yeah...if only.
lines.zh: : 是啊……要是有就好了。

lines.en: scene ioarchery2
: Oh well. Since there’s not, wanna go hang out in the shade where I can say more clingy things without either of us having to worry about some bitch with a side ponytail going rogue and killing us?
lines.zh: : 算了。既然没有，要不要去阴凉地待着？在那儿我可以说更多黏人的话，咱俩都不用担心某个扎侧马尾的婊子突然发疯杀了我们。

lines.en: : As long as you don’t try introducing me to your caterpillar friend. I’m not very fond of insects.
lines.zh: : 只要你别把你的毛毛虫朋友介绍给我就行。我不太喜欢昆虫。

lines.en: : Cody the Caterpillar would be very upset to hear that, but sure. I can probably keep our little retreat bug-free if that’s what you want.
lines.zh: : 毛毛虫 Cody 听了会很伤心，不过行吧。如果你想的话，我们这场小小的私奔我可以保证没有虫子。

lines.en: scene black
Io and I sneak away from Uta and Wakana, walking behind the rest of the girls as well in hopes of them not seeing where we’re about to run off to.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 悄悄从 Uta 和 Wakana 身边溜走，还绕到其他女生身后，指望她们看不到我们要往哪儿跑。

lines.en: She takes me behind a small building where I’m assuming they store all of their equipment and slaps the wall of it as if to tell me this is where we’ll be hiding for now.
lines.zh: 她把我带到一栋小楼后面——我猜她们把器材都存在那儿——然后拍了拍墙，像是告诉我：我们暂时就藏这儿了。

lines.en: scene ioarchery4
Given the type of person she is, I’m not surprised to find that she’s already uncovered a location concealed from the prying eyes of girls she tells herself she despises.
lines.zh: 考虑到她是什么样的人，她早就找到了一个能避开那些她口口声声说讨厌的女生视线的藏身处，我一点都不意外。

lines.en: I think whether or not she actually does is another story entirely.
lines.zh: 至于她到底是不是真讨厌她们，那就是另一回事了。

lines.en: It’s easier to block people out than to let them in, and if you convince yourself that everyone is someone to be hated before even meeting them, you can shield yourself from being let down.
lines.zh: 把人挡在外面，总比放进来容易；只要在见面之前就说服自己「每个人都值得讨厌」，你就能保护自己免于失望。

lines.en: But what you shouldn’t be doing along with that is constantly drawing attention to it, for when you doubt yourself to begin with, the last thing you’ll benefit from is the sound of your own voice.
lines.zh: 但你同时不该做的，是不停地把这件事挂在嘴上——因为你本来就自我怀疑，此时最没好处的就是听见自己的声音。

lines.en: Unfortunately, I think Io has gotten so used to the act of blocking things out that, more often than not, the sound of her own voice is the only thing she hears.
lines.zh: 遗憾的是，我觉得 Io 已经太习惯把东西挡在外面，以至于大多数时候，她唯一听见的只剩下自己的声音。

lines.en: And if I were her, I’d be annoyed by that too.
lines.zh: 如果我是她，我也会烦的。

lines.en: : So...what do you want to talk about? The weather? The news? What our plans are for this weekend and how we don’t actually have any, so we’re going to spend the entire time with each other?
lines.zh: : 那么……你想聊点什么？天气？新闻？还是我们这周末的安排——以及我们其实根本没有任何安排，所以打算整天都腻在一起这件事？

lines.en: : Smooth.
lines.zh: : 挺溜啊。

lines.en: scene ioarchery5
: I can be good at stuff when I want to be. I just don’t normally want to be.
lines.zh: : 只要我想，我是能把事情做好的。只不过我通常不想。

lines.en: : I guess I might be able to free up some time this weekend. Or next weekend. Or some weekend.
lines.zh: : 我想这周末我大概能腾出点时间。或者下周末。或者随便哪个周末。

lines.en: : Or whenever I really think about it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 或者，等我真正认真想过之后再说吧，大概。

lines.en: : The fact that I cross your mind at all is already more than I deserve, so whenever works for you is what is best for me.
lines.zh: : 光是你能想到我，就已经是我配不上的了。所以你什么时候方便，对我来说就是最好的。

lines.en: : Other than mornings, apparently. Since you are now defying all expectations and actually coming to club meetings.
lines.zh: : 不过早上显然不行。因为你现在打破了一切预期，居然真的来参加社团活动了。

lines.en: scene ioarchery6
: That’s not something I have to do, though. I’m just trying to make Uta happy since she’s always going above and beyond for me.
lines.zh: : 不过那不是我非做不可的事。我只是想让 Uta 开心——她总是为我付出那么多。

lines.en: : The truth is that I kind of hate archery. I think it’s annoying and stupidly traditional and that the outfits are too hot.
lines.zh: : 说实话我其实挺讨厌弓道的。我觉得它烦人、传统得愚蠢，服装还热得要命。

lines.en: : I guess the woodworking on some of the bows is really neat, though. I wonder if I’d be able to make one with a little practice?
lines.zh: : 不过有些弓上的木工活儿确实挺精致的。不知道练一练我能不能自己也做一把？

lines.en: : You picked a weird club to join for someone who apparently hates archery.
lines.zh: : 对一个显然讨厌弓道的人来说，你选了个挺奇怪的社团。

lines.en: : True. But I hate most things, so I was kind of screwed the moment they announced we had to join a club.
lines.zh: : 说得对。但我讨厌大多数东西，所以他们一宣布必须参加社团，我基本就完蛋了。

lines.en: : I tried to get out of it the best I could by just not submitting the paper, but then I realized that being disciplined might mean I wouldn’t get to see you anymore, so I backtracked and just did what Uta was doing.
lines.zh: : 我本来拼命想逃过去，就是不交那张表；但后来我意识到，被处分可能就意味着再也见不到你了，于是我反悔了，Uta 干什么我就干什么。

lines.en: : Seems to be a recurring thing for me, really. Just following her lead since she’s able to actually walk without her feet being chained to giant cinderblocks.
lines.zh: : 说实话这对我是常态。反正就是跟着她走——她至少能正常走路，脚上没拴着巨大的水泥块。

lines.en: : You’re not always following her lead, though. If you were, you’d have more than one friend.
lines.zh: : 可你也不是总跟着她走。要是真跟着，你的朋友就不止一个了。

lines.en: scene ioarchery7
: Excuse me, good sir. I have two friends. I just have an unquenchable desire to cuddle and watch movies with one of them.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，这位先生。我有两个朋友。我只是对其中一个有着无法抑制的、想抱着她一起看电影的欲望。

lines.en: : Does Uta know you feel that way about her?
lines.zh: : Uta 知道你对她有这种感觉吗？

lines.en: : Hmm...she does seem like she’d be a good cuddler. I think I’d rather be with someone a little taller, though. Someone with a penis.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她看起来确实挺适合抱的。不过我更想跟个子高一点的人在一起。有阴茎的那种人。

lines.en: scene ioarchery8
: Well, I sure hope Uta doesn’t have one of those.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我真心希望 Uta 没有那玩意儿。

lines.en: : It’s funny because I was sure she did have one of those back in the day. Boy, was that a surprise.
lines.zh: : 好笑的是，以前我敢肯定她是有那玩意儿的。天哪，那可真是个惊喜。

lines.en: : Weird friendship backstory aside, I think it might be good for you if you actually...you know...did make another female friend.
lines.zh: : 先不谈你们那诡异的友情背景故事，我觉得你要是真能……你知道的……再交个女性朋友，也许对你有好处。

lines.en: : Pass. I’m content with the one that I have now. Any more would be a fucking nightmare.
lines.zh: : 免了。我现在有这一个就够了。再多一个就是场他妈的噩梦。

lines.en: : What if it was someone like Kirin?
lines.zh: : 如果是 Kirin 那样的人呢？

lines.en: scene ioarchery9
: That would be even worse! You suggested literally the last person in class I would even consider being friends with!
lines.zh: : 那就更糟了好吗！你说的是全班我最后一个才会考虑跟她做朋友的人！

lines.en: : And why is that?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Have you seen how toxic that girl is? There’s so much poison pouring out of everything she says that the whole room starts dying the moment she speaks.
lines.zh: : 你没看见那姑娘有多毒吗？她说的每句话都在往外冒毒液，她一开口，整个房间就开始凋零。

lines.en: : You’re pretty toxic yourself, though.
lines.zh: : 可你自己也挺毒的。

lines.en: : Do you think I’d seize the opportunity to be friends with myself? Because that’s the only thing I can think of that would be even worse than Kirin.
lines.zh: : 你觉得我会抓住机会跟自己做朋友吗？因为这是我唯一能想到的、比 Kirin 更糟的事了。

lines.en: : One of the key reasons I like Uta so much is that she’s the complete opposite of that. She like, kills toxicity. It’s good for counteracting the things I do.
lines.zh: : 我那么喜欢 Uta，一个关键原因就是她完全相反。她简直就是「以毒攻毒」。正好能中和我的那些毛病。

lines.en: scene ioarchery10
: I’m just saying I think you two have a lot in common and that you’d be able to talk without inherently hating one another.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得你俩有很多共同点，而且你们能好好说话，不至于一开口就本能地讨厌对方。

lines.en: : At the very least, it seems like she wants to be friends with you.
lines.zh: : 至少，她看起来是想跟你做朋友的。

lines.en: : I don’t really care about what Kirin wants.
lines.zh: : 我才不在乎 Kirin 想要什么。

lines.en: : Do you care about what I want?
lines.zh: : 那你在乎我想要的吗？

lines.en: : Of course.
lines.zh: : 当然。

lines.en: : Just not when it’s something that conflicts with your own personal interests?
lines.zh: : 除非那事跟你的个人利益冲突？

lines.en: scene ioarchery11
: Where’s this coming from? I just wanted to hang out with you and have fun. If I wanted to confront my demons first thing in the morning, I would have medicated before leaving the house.
lines.zh: : 你这话从哪儿冒出来的？我只是想跟你待着、开心一下而已。要是我一大早就想直面心魔，我出门前就该把药吃了。

lines.en: : Just a thought. I could have kept it inside but I figured that was pointless since you don’t keep anything inside ever.
lines.zh: : 随口一说。我本来可以憋着不说，但想想没意义——反正你什么都憋不住。

lines.en: scene ioarchery12
: I keep plenty inside.
lines.zh: : 我憋着的东西多着呢。

lines.en: : Like what?
lines.zh: : 比如？

lines.en: : Like how I hate that you like Kirin when she’s just one out of millions of other fakes wandering around Japan, hoping to find something to make her feel whole.
lines.zh: : 比如我讨厌你喜欢 Kirin——她不过是成千上万个游荡在日本各地的冒牌货之一，盼着找到点什么能让自己变得完整。

lines.en: : I also hate her lack of understanding when it comes to people’s boundaries as she would literally not stop questioning me about you on the way back home from the Christmas party.
lines.zh: : 我还讨厌她对别人的边界毫无概念——圣诞派对回家的路上，她就揪着我问你的事，真的没完没了。

lines.en: : But I realize that’s less of a thing I was keeping inside and more of a thing I just didn’t share with you due to lack of timely relevancy.
lines.zh: : 但我意识到，这与其说是我在憋着，不如说只是因为时机不对才没告诉你。

lines.en: : She questioned you on the way back home from the Christmas thing?
lines.zh: : 圣诞那次活动回家的路上，她一直在问你？

lines.en: : Relentlessly. And the vast majority of it was extremely personal. Things no one should just blatantly and unabashedly discuss despite barely knowing one another.
lines.zh: : 无休无止。而且绝大部分都非常私密。明明彼此根本不熟，有些事就不该那么厚脸皮、毫无顾忌地拿来问。

lines.en: scene ioarchery13
: Yeah...that sounds like her.
lines.zh: : 是啊……这很她。

lines.en: : I’ve got...limits, you know? Like, not everything is easy for me to just talk about.
lines.zh: : 我是有……限度的，你知道吧？不是所有事我都能轻松说出口。

lines.en: : And if I had somebody in my life who was always trying to force that out of me...well, things would suck even more than they do right now.
lines.zh: : 要是我身边有个人总想把这些从我嘴里逼出来……嗯，那日子会比现在还糟。

lines.en: : I get that. But I also think you also have to understand that if things suck right now, they’re going to keep sucking for the rest of forever unless you actually do something about it.
lines.zh: : 我懂。但我也觉得你得明白：要是现在很糟，而你什么都不做，那它会一直糟下去，永远糟下去。

lines.en: : Would you rather get to know someone who’s interested in getting to know you, despite all of the obstacles you throw their way...or someone who’s shown no interest in you whatsoever?
lines.zh: : 你更愿意去了解一个——尽管你设置了重重障碍——仍想了解你的人，还是一个对你完全没兴趣的人？

lines.en: : The latter. Anyone who shows any interest in me has extraordinarily bad taste.
lines.zh: : 后者。任何对我表现出兴趣的人，品味都差得出奇。

lines.en: : Try it again but with less self-loathing.
lines.zh: : 再答一次，这次少点自我厌恶。

lines.en: scene ioarchery14
: But that’s so hard! You’re taking away my most defining trait!
lines.zh: : 可那太难了！你在剥夺我最标志性的特质！

lines.en: : Yeah, well when your most defining trait is also your biggest weakness as a person, it’s good to peel it back every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可当你最标志性的特质同时也是你作为一个人最大的弱点时，时不时把它剥开一层是好事。

lines.en: : Being depended on is cool and all and I’m glad that you...think you’re whatever that weird burrowing sperm fish is-
lines.zh: : 被人依赖是很酷啦，我也很高兴你……觉得自己是那种奇怪的、会挖洞的精子鱼——

lines.en: : Anglerfish.
lines.zh: : 鮟鱇鱼。

lines.en: : Yeah, that. I’m glad you’re able to think up weird metaphors about our relationship because it solidifies my sense of importance when it comes to your life and...that’s a thing I think I need.
lines.zh: : 对，那个。我很高兴你能想出关于我们关系的奇怪比喻，因为它让我在你生命里的分量变得更实在，而……这大概是我需要的东西。

lines.en: : But I also want you to be able to exist on your own because you remind me of myself and I still don’t really know how to do that.
lines.zh: : 但我也希望你能靠自己活下去——因为你让我想起我自己，而我自己到现在也不知道该怎么做。

lines.en: scene ioarchery15
: Did you just...
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是……

lines.en: : Did you just open up to me?
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是对我敞开心扉了？

lines.en: : I guess. But I did it more for myself than I did for you.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过我做这件事，更多是为了我自己，不是为了你。

lines.en: : Watching you “succeed” would be for my own personal benefit at the end of the day. And if getting you to feel uncomfortable in pursuit of that is what it winds up taking, I want you to be uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 说到底，看着你「成功」是为了我自己的利益。如果为了这个得让你不舒服，那就让你不舒服吧。

lines.en: : Me...making more friends...will somehow make you feel better about yourself?
lines.zh: : 我……交更多朋友……会以某种方式让你对自己感觉更好？

lines.en: : It’s weird how our minds work sometimes, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我们的脑子有时候运作方式真奇怪，是不是？

lines.en: scene ioarchery16
: That’s so strange. Because any time I think of you forming more relationships, I just get pissed off and jealous.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。因为每当我想到你建立更多关系，我就只会生气、嫉妒。

lines.en: : Not all of my relationships are sexual, you know.
lines.zh: : 我的关系又不全是性的，你知道吧。

lines.en: : I guess not. But according to Kirin, the ones you care most about are.
lines.zh: : 大概不是。但按 Kirin 的说法，你最在乎的那几个都是。

lines.en: : Why she’d somehow spin that into pressuring me to crumble when she very obviously likes you as well, I don’t get.
lines.zh: : 她明明也很明显喜欢你，却还能把这件事扭曲成逼我崩溃的手段，我实在搞不懂。

lines.en: : But I guess that all of our minds are little messed up when you start applying actual logic to them.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，一旦你拿真正的逻辑去套，我们所有人的脑子都有点不正常。

lines.en: : Is it too much to ask for a brain that doesn’t break down every time you try to use it?
lines.zh: : 想要一个不会每次一用就崩溃的大脑，这要求很过分吗？

lines.en: : It’s too much to ask for anything. Life is going to give us what it gives us and all we can do is scarf it down or starve ourselves. There’s no third option.
lines.zh: : 要求什么都是过分。生活会给什么就给什么，我们要么狼吞虎咽咽下去，要么活活饿死。没有第三个选项。

lines.en: : Life kind of sucks, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 人生挺烂的，是不是？

lines.en: : Why else would we constantly try to distract ourselves from it?
lines.zh: : 不然我们干嘛总要想方设法转移注意力？

lines.en: : This was a good talk. I enjoyed this.
lines.zh: : 这番谈话挺好的。我很享受。

lines.en: : I figured I was still like, a year away from learning anything about you. So the fact that I now think I understand something is...
lines.zh: : 我本来以为，要再过差不多一年我才能了解到你的任何事。所以现在我觉得自己理解了点什么，这种感觉是……

lines.en: : I guess for lack of a better term-
lines.zh: : 我想，找不到更好的词的话——

lines.en: : A good distraction.
lines.zh: : 一个好的消遣。

lines.en: scene black
Io and I leave our spot behind the storage building and wander back into the lives of everyone else, knowing full well that our prior distraction had overstayed its welcome.
lines.zh: 我和 Io 离开器材室后面那块地方，重新游荡回其他人的生活里——我们心里都很清楚，刚才那场消遣已经赖得太久了。

lines.en: I’m glad she has another one now, though.
lines.zh: 不过我很高兴，她现在有了一个新的。

lines.en: What I’m not glad about is that it now feels like a small piece of me is missing.
lines.zh: 我不高兴的是，现在感觉像是有一小块我从身上缺掉了。

lines.en: But when I’m the one who ripped it off and so carefully placed it into her hands, I don’t really have any right to complain.
lines.zh: 可既然是我亲手把它撕下来、又小心翼翼地放进她手里的，我也实在没资格抱怨。

lines.en: When we round the corner, I step on something soft.
lines.zh: 我们拐过转角时，我踩到了一个软软的东西。

lines.en: It sticks to my shoe and I have to kick the dirt in order to get it off.
lines.zh: 它黏在了我的鞋底，我不得不去蹭地上的土才能弄掉。

lines.en: I won’t tell you what it was.
lines.zh: 我不会告诉你们那是什么。

lines.en: $ ioarchery1 = True
$ io_love += 1
Io’s affection has increased to [io_love]!
lines.zh: Io 的好感度提升到了 [io_love]!

lines.en: jump utaarchery1
